title: I Am Sitting in a Room (Re-encoded)
summary: A panel of text re-encodes itself as JPEG every frame until the codec's own resonant frequencies erase the words.
mechanism: Recursive client-side canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg') feedback loop (re-encode + slight zoom/rotate each generation) whose accumulating 8x8 DCT block artifacts are the medium's resonant modes.
references: Alvin Lucier, I Am Sitting in a Room (1969)
net.art / generational loss (the re-uploaded, re-encoded file)
JPEG / discrete cosine transform basis functions
